commits.subject: fix: round-3 review (final) — 6 fixes, 3 writeup corrections, 1 deferral
commits.body:
gpt-5.6-sol over the round-2 fixes + F9 analysis, with authority to
re-run the numbers on the box. The round's headline: round-2's commit
message CLAIMED the R3 fail-closed sync fix without the code edit
(already remedied in d960958 mid-review) — commit messages are now part
of the reviewed surface.

- F2  deploy resets the box to the run's TESTED SHA (github.sha), not
      mutable origin/deploy: an in-flight run could ship a later queued
      commit whose own test/environment gate never ran
- F3  aged contradicted shadow records EXCLUDED from the sample (a
      void-equivalent reclassification), not annotated-and-carried;
      nightly update prints the warning into cron.log
- F6  backup last-success carry resolves against the FRESH on-disk
      prior under the flock (slow run vs concurrent peer); a success
      with a missing summary snapshot_id keeps the prior pin
- F7  legacy v1 status artifacts labeled instead of rendering a retired
      nightly-Wilson verdict as pre-registered
- F9  dangling-symlink units WARN (is_symlink before exists)
- F4/F5/F8 writeup corrections: '<<0.005 bound' RETRACTED (slot-average
      argument misapplied to a rank statistic; positions 1-4 touched on
      11.6% of dates); live check restated as 0/218 unique sides
      (95% UB 1.36%) with conditioning caveats; lineup proxy documented.
      Skip-Stage-2 conclusion stands on decision-insensitivity grounds.
      Part-2 live-check code committed into the analysis script.
- F1  deferred: cached-fallback can deliver a postponed-game pick when
      no replacement is eligible — pre-existing, contest outcome
      identical to no-pick, folds into the postponed-awareness call

Suite 1801 -> 1808. Review cap reached; converged.
